Most likely the issue is with the mod_rewrite apache module on your hosting setup. If your subpages are throwing 404 errors but the homepage works, your .htaccess file just needs to be re-configured.

I fixed this exact issue yesterday for a WooCommerce store. It takes about 15 minutes to sort out.

Do you have access to your cPanel or hosting backend right now so I can take a look?
